responsibility: Defines the major interface that declares Modula-2 symbols and types to GCC once their dependencies are sufficiently resolved. It covers constant and constructor declaration, procedure and variable declaration, scope entry, export marking, dependency walking callbacks, basic type min/max queries, and constant-folding support, making it the front-end contract for turning symbol-table entities into GCC-known declarations and types.
same_name_distinction: This definition module is the exported declaration-stage interface between gm2 semantic state and GCC, listing the procedures other compiler parts may call to declare symbols, constants, procedures, and types. The paired `M2GCCDeclare.mod` contains the substantial dependency-resolution machinery and state that decide when those declarations can actually be completed.
